name: ratlab
description: On-demand game development and visual QA workflows, with optional local browser checks.

interface.longDescription: On-demand guidance for game creation, procedural animation, VFX, world-building, and visual QA. Your host agent keeps its native tools, model choice, permissions, and subagents. Includes an optional local browser script for screenshots and frame cadence checks; no server or external model calls.
defaultPrompt: Help me build and visually verify a small playable game.
